Hi Jessica,

Thanks again for agreeing to an on‑site immersion at our Novato HQ. We want to make the visit productive and low‑friction for your team. Proposed window: Tue, Mar 14 — arrival 10:00am, run 10:30–2:30 (we'll do lunch on site). Can you confirm whether that works for you and who will be attending?

Logistics we need to lock down:
- NDA: please sign the attached mutual_action_plan.xlsx (page 2 is the short NDA) or we can push the formal NDA via DocuSign if you prefer.
- Badging: send full legal names + government ID type for everyone so Facilities can preprint badges.
- Room & AV: we'd like Conference Delta (capacity 12) with HDMI + wireless screen share.
- Hardware: if you want us to stage any demo laptops, share spec list; otherwise bring up to 3 visitor laptops.
- Parking: street parking is limited — we can reserve 2 visitor spots if you confirm license plates ahead of time.

I attached a quick HQ room layout (hq_room_layout.pdf) and a draft run of show in the spreadsheet. Marissa (SE) will lead the product portion; Dev (CS) will be on logistics and badging.

Next steps:
1) Confirm attendee list + preferred arrival time
2) Sign NDA (or request DocuSign link)
3) Any dietary restrictions for lunch

Appreciate it — want to make this smooth for you.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555‑0128
